result.topic_en: Riemann writes log ζ(s) as a Dirichlet series over prime powers, inserts a convergence factor e^{-βm} m^{-1/2}, and converts the resulting sum (with a sine of s log m) into integrals in x involving log x, sin and cos terms, and series over α.
result.transcription:
$\log \zeta(s) = \sum p^{-s} + \frac{1}{2}\sum p^{-2s} + \frac{1}{3}\sum p^{-3s}$
$= \sum \varepsilon_m m^{-s}$

$\sum \varepsilon_m e^{-\beta m} m^{-\frac{1}{2}}$ [-...-] $\sin \log m\, s$

$= \int_1^\infty \frac{e^{-\beta x} x^{-\frac{1}{2}} \sin(\log x\, s)}{\log x} \partial x - \sum^\alpha 2 \int_1^\infty \frac{e^{-\beta x} x^{-1} \sin(\log x\, s) \cos(\log x\, \alpha)\, \partial x}{\log x}$ [-...-] $- \int_1^\infty \frac{e^{-\beta x} x^{-\frac{3}{2}}}{xx-1} \frac{\sin(s \log x)\, \partial x}{\log x}$

$= \int_1^\infty \frac{e^{-\beta x} x^{-\frac{1}{2}} \sin s \log x}{\log x} \partial x - \int_1^\infty \frac{e^{-\beta x} x^{-\frac{3}{2}} \sin s \log x}{xx-1 \log x} \partial x - \sum^\alpha \Big( 2 \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-\beta x} \sin s \log x \cos \alpha \log x\, \partial x}{x \log x} - 2 \int_0^1 \frac{\sin s \log x \cos \alpha \log x\, \partial x}{x \log x} \Big)$
$+ \sum_1^\infty \sum^\alpha 2 \int_0^1 \frac{(-\beta)^n}{n!} x^{n-1} \frac{\sin s \log x \cos \alpha \log x\, \partial x}{\log x}$

methods.what: Euler product expansion of log ζ(s) as sum over prime powers, written as a Dirichlet series with coefficients ε_m
Smoothed (Abel-type damped) sum of prime-power coefficients with factor e^{-βm} m^{-1/2} and sin(s log m)
Explicit-formula type representation of the damped sum as an integral of the logarithmic-integral main term minus sum over zeros α and a trivial-zero term
methods.quote: $= \int_1^\infty \frac{e^{-\beta x} x^{-\frac{1}{2}} \sin(\log x\, s)}{\log x} \partial x - \sum^\alpha 2 \int_1^\infty \frac{e^{-\beta x} x^{-1} \sin(\log x\, s) \cos(\log x\, \alpha)\, \partial x}{\log x}$

methods.what: Splitting the integral over zeros into ∫_0^∞ minus ∫_0^1 and expanding e^{-βx} in power series on [0,1]
methods.quote: $+ \sum_1^\infty \sum^\alpha 2 \int_0^1 \frac{(-\beta)^n}{n!} x^{n-1} \frac{\sin s \log x \cos \alpha \log x\, \partial x}{\log x}$
